subject: Post-demo: MAP draft & integration implementation timeline
messages:
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.com>
To: Claire Nguyen <claire@humatech.io>
Cc: Rafael Mendes <rafael@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-09-19T17:02:00-07:00
Subject: Post-demo: MAP draft & integration implementation timeline

Hi Claire —

Thanks again for taking the time today. Per our demo and discovery, I put together a first-pass Mutual Action Plan (attached) that focuses on the integration build milestones we discussed: SDK onboarding, streaming ingestion, tool-calling hooks, and structured output schema. High level:

- Proposed target close: 2026-10-28 (customer P0).
- Key MAP milestones in the attachment:
  1) Integration scoping & alignment — confirm API surfaces and data flow (owner: HumaTech / Redwood scribe)
  2) SDK integration POC — Redwood sample app + HumaTech test harness (owner: Ben C.)
  3) Streaming ingestion and KV/cache sizing — basic throughput targets and failover (owner: Dev P.)
  4) Tool calling & structured outputs — define tool interfaces and response schema (owner: Ben C.)
  5) Security & compliance intake — vendor checklist + SOC2 evidence (owner: HumaTech)
  6) Cutover & smoke tests — pre-prod validation and rollout plan (owner: joint)

Open questions we flagged during the call:
- Which HumaTech engineer will own the SDK POC?
- Do you have a preferred format for structured output (JSON-LD vs. flattened JSON)?
- Are there networking constraints (VPC peering) we need to schedule with infra?

Next steps I propose:
1) You review the attached MAP_v1 and indicate owners for each milestone.
2) We run a 30m technical sync (Redwood eng + HumaTech engs) to refine the SDK/streaming tasks — propose Wed 9/22 10:00 PT.
3) We update MAP to v2 and lock a target close date by next Friday.

Attachments: MAP_v1_humatech.xlsx; integration_scope_overview.pdf

If that plan works, can you confirm the internal owners (name + email) for the POC and security intake?

Thanks,
Vanessa Ortiz
Enterprise AE, Redwood Inference
vanessa@redwood.com

---
Attachment stubs:
- MAP_v1_humatech.xlsx (spreadsheet: milestones, dates, owners)
- integration_scope_overview.pdf (2-pg: diagram of API surface and data flow)

From: Claire Nguyen <claire@humatech.io>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-09-20T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Post-demo: MAP draft & integration implementation timeline

Hi Vanessa —

Appreciate the write-up and the MAP draft. Quick answers from our side:
- Our internal owners: Emily Park (CTO, emily@humatech.io) will own product sign-off; Marcus Lin (Lead Eng, marcus@humatech.io) will own the SDK POC and the on-prem networking. I will coordinate security/compliance intake.
- For structured outputs, Marcus prefers a flattened JSON initially; we can evolve to JSON-LD if needed later.
- We need more detail on streaming backpressure and KV/cache sizing before committing to the Oct 28 target. Marcus asked whether Redwood can provide a reference throughput matrix for expected TPS and token sizes.
- We have a vendor security intake form — attaching now. Can you confirm which SOC2 artifacts Redwood can provide?

We also have a scheduling constraint: several of our infra folks are out the week of 10/11, so if possible we'd like to push the contractual close to 2026-10-28 as you proposed (that still works) but we'd prefer to lock milestones earlier so we can start work in early Oct.

Attachment: security_request_form.pdf

Best,
Claire
Director of Platform, HumaTech
claire@humatech.io

---
Attachment stubs:
- security_request_form.pdf (PDF: vendor security questionnaire)

From: Rafael Mendes <rafael@redwood.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.com>; Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>; Dev Patel <dev@redwood.com>
Cc: Grace O'Connor <grace@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-09-20T14:30:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Post-demo: MAP draft & integration implementation timeline

Vanessa / team —

Thanks Claire for the quick turnaround and the security form. Short internal alignment notes and proposed owner assignments so we can update MAP_v2:

- SDK POC (Ben Carter) — scope: Redwood SDK integration sample, login/auth examples, end-to-end sample requests + response validation. Deliverable: SDK sample repo + onboarding doc. ETA: 2 weeks from kickoff (target 2026-10-06).
- Streaming ingestion & KV sizing (Dev Patel) — scope: throughput/backpressure tests, target TPS matrix for token sizes 64/256/1024, and recommended KV cache sizes for session lengths. Deliverable: perf matrix + recommended runtime config. ETA: 3 weeks from kickoff (target 2026-10-13).
- Tool calling & structured outputs (Ben + Grace O'Connor) — scope: define tool interface contracts, fallback behaviors, and example structured outputs (flattened JSON per HumaTech request). Deliverable: contract doc + example outputs. ETA: 2 weeks from kickoff (target 2026-10-06).
- Security intake (HumaTech) — Rafael: we'll provide SOC2 type II report excerpt, data retention policy, and network architecture diagram. Grace will own assembling the security artifact bundle and the internal review.

Dependencies we need to track:
1) HumaTech to provide test account + sample payloads (auth, request shapes) — owner: Marcus (HumaTech).
2) Network access / VPC peering window — need dates from HumaTech infra.
3) Security questionnaire clarifications — Claire to provide any showstoppers.

Action items I put on the MAP_v2 spreadsheet (attached):
- Fill owner names & emails in each milestone row.
- Add engineering kickoff: propose 2026-09-22 10:00 PT (Vanessa to send invite).

I attached proposed_MAP_v2.xlsx with updated owners and target dates. Vanessa, can you confirm the kickoff time and I’ll block internal heads?

Rafael
Director, Solutions Engineering, Redwood Inference
rafael@redwood.com

---

- proposed_MAP_v2.xlsx (spreadsheet: owners assigned, tentative dates)

- Kickoff: Technical sync scheduled for 2026-09-22 10:00 PT (calendar invite attached).
- Confirmed internal owners:
  • SDK POC — Ben Carter (ben@redwood.com)
  • Streaming & perf matrix — Dev Patel (dev@redwood.com)
  • Tool-calling & structured outputs — Ben Carter + Grace O'Connor (grace@redwood.com)
  • Security bundle assembly — Grace O'Connor (internal), Claire to own submission on HumaTech side.
- Dependencies due from HumaTech by 2026-09-28: test account credentials, sample payloads, and preferred network windows.
